content.comment_body: Hello, I want to display the output state of a slave [product_name] device in [product_name] Web Editor, but I'm unsure how to do it. I know how to use the output address of the master device (like q1), but I can't figure out the method for the slave.
Are you referring to the Master/Slave procedure, or do you mean the Client/Server procedure?
I mean the Master/Slave procedure. In this case, I want to display the state of an output block from a slave [product_name] device.

For example, in this scenario, I want to show the status of NQ1 (Q1 of Slave 1) in [product_name] Web Editor, but I'm not sure how to do it. I can only represent the status using Q15, but not NQ1 directly.

Follow the example in the attached file. Use a digital network output and assign it to a local variable memory (VM) with an available address in the VM range. Alternatively, you can simply use Q15, as Q15 mirrors NQ1 and reflects the same state.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking advice on how to display the output status of a slave device within [product_name] Web Editor, specifically looking to access and visualize a particular output (NQ1) in a master/slave configuration. The user finds it confusing to map the desired slave output and is unclear about the addressing system in [product_name] Web Editor. This issue results from a lack of clear documentation on the process for mapping or displaying outputs from slave devices, leading to difficulties for those using networked [product_name] systems.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple and straightforward way to map and view the state of a specific output from a slave [product_name] device in [product_name] Web Editor, similar to how master outputs are handled.
